title: mr create: without --head, the source project comes from the current directory's git remote, causing "Source project is not a fork of the target project"
description:
## Summary

`glab mr create --repo <project-b>` sends the request to the project of the git remote in the current directory when `--head` is not set. If that project is not a fork of `--repo`, GitLab rejects the request with `422 Source project is not a fork of the target project`. The error does not say that the source project was taken from the local clone.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Two projects on gitlab.com that are not forks of each other: `group/project-a` and `group/project-b`.
2. Branch `my-branch` exists on the remote of `group/project-b`.
3. Start glab in a local clone of `group/project-a`. I reproduced it through `glab mcp serve`, whose working directory is fixed when the server starts.
4. Run the equivalent of:

   ```shell
   glab mr create --repo group/project-b --source-branch my-branch --target-branch main \
     --title "Test" --description "Test" --yes
   ```

## What happens

The request goes to `POST /api/v4/projects/group%2Fproject-a/merge_requests` and fails with:

```text
422 {message: [Source project is not a fork of the target project]}
```

## What I expected

When `--repo` is set and `--head` is not, I expected the source project to be the same as `--repo`, or at least a clear message that the source project was taken from the local remote.

## Workaround

Pass `--head group/project-b` as well. The request then goes to `projects/group%2Fproject-b/merge_requests`, and the MR is created with the correct source and target project.

## Notes

- !3623 describes the cause: "Without an explicit `--head`/`GITLAB_HEAD_REPO`, the resolver still consults local remotes so fork workflows keep auto-detecting the source."
- Not verified: I did not run the plain CLI from a terminal. The behaviour above is from `glab mcp serve`. The code path described in !3623 suggests it is the same.
- Related: #1329, #7696, #7780.

## Environment

- glab 1.124.0 (d43ccacec)
- gitlab.com
